The '''Sojourn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Carrion sector/Legends|Carrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]].
